$schema.description: An optional JSON Schema reference, kept unchanged.

seed.description: The seed the run starts with.

frames.description: The number of frames to run.

input.description: Input changes, in frame order. An action keeps its last value until changed.

raw.description:
Raw key and mouse changes, in frame order, for layers that read keys
rather than actions (the compatibility layer's input services).

commands.description: Engine commands to dispatch, in frame order.

checks.description: Checks to make, in frame order.

ReplayInput.description:
A change of one action's value at a frame.

Exactly one of `down` (a button action) and `axis` (an axis action) is set.

frame.description: The frame at which the value changes.

RawReplayInput.description:
One raw device change in a replay: a key or mouse button going down or
up, the cursor moving, or the wheel turning. Exactly one of `key`,
`mouse_button`, `mouse_move`, `mouse_position` and `wheel` is set; `key`
and `mouse_button` also need `down`.

```json
{ "frame": 30, "key": "W", "down": true }
{ "frame": 31, "mouse_move": [12, -4] }
```

frame.description: The frame the change happens on.

key.description: A key or gamepad button name (`W`, `Space`, `ButtonA`).

mouse_button.description: A mouse button: 1 left, 2 right, 3 middle.

mouse_position.description: The cursor's new position in window pixels.

wheel.description: A wheel turn, in notches (positive away from the user).

ReplayCommand.description: An engine command (from the command registry) dispatched at a frame.

frame.description: The frame at which it is dispatched (before the frame's fixed steps).

ReplayCheck.description: A check made at the end of a frame.

frame.description: The frame after which the check runs.

screenshot.description:
Capture the frame and compare it with this golden image. `{backend}` is
replaced by the backend the run uses (`vulkan` or `gl`).
